name: JSON Format
description: Format, validate and fold JSON while preserving every original value.

app.title: JSON Format · Toolbox
app.description: Paste JSON to format, validate and fold it instantly. Processed in your browser, with lossless numbers, copy and download.

state.emptyBody: Paste JSON on the left. Formatted output appears automatically.
state.pendingBody: Keeping every value, refining the layout.

errors.InvalidSymbol: Invalid character. Use standard JSON syntax.
errors.InvalidNumberFormat: Invalid number. Check the decimal point or exponent.
errors.PropertyNameExpected: Property names must use double quotes.
errors.ValueExpected: A valid JSON value is missing here.
errors.ColonExpected: Missing colon : after the property name.
errors.CommaExpected: Missing comma , between properties or elements.
errors.CloseBraceExpected: Missing closing brace } for the object.
errors.CloseBracketExpected: Missing closing bracket ] for the array.
errors.EndOfFileExpected: Unexpected content after JSON. Enter a single JSON value.
errors.InvalidCommentToken: Standard JSON does not allow comments. Remove the comment.
errors.UnexpectedEndOfComment: Unterminated comment. Standard JSON does not allow comments.
errors.UnexpectedEndOfString: Missing closing double quote for the string.
errors.UnexpectedEndOfNumber: Incomplete number. Complete the decimal or exponent.
errors.InvalidUnicode: Unicode escapes must use \u followed by four hexadecimal digits.
errors.InvalidEscapeCharacter: Invalid escape character in the string.
errors.InvalidCharacter: Unescaped control character in the string.
errors.TooDeep: Nesting exceeds {{limit}} levels. Simplify the JSON structure.
errors.WorkerUnavailable: The formatter could not start. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.ProcessingFailed: Unable to process this content. Reduce its size or check the JSON structure.
